about: memory.mts --budgets: what the game holds at the playable title on SwiftShader (the CI no-GPU boot smoke job runs it after boot). A number over its budget fails; a number more than underPct under fails until the budget is lowered (the failure names the new value, measured plus headroomPct), so budgets only go down. Set 2026-11-05 with every PR of this batch merged in order: three runs on 4 vCPUs gave WebGL 1418.1 MB (textures 1261.1 MB in 246, buffers 136.3), geometry CPU 169.3-169.6 MB, texture CPU 427.6 MB.
